hero.title: Protect Your Photos & PDFs from AI Scrapers
hero.summary: VeriMedia is a secure tool that works entirely in your browser. It removes hidden location data and private tracking info from your photos and PDFs, while adding your personal copyright and AI opt-out tags in seconds.

kb.title: How VeriMedia Protects Your Work
kb.ai_desc: VeriMedia adds a standard "AI Opt-Out" tag to your files. This sends a clear signal to AI scrapers that your work is off-limits for model training datasets.
kb.privacy_desc: We remove hidden tracking data like GPS locations and camera serial numbers while permanently embedding your personal copyright and ownership info.
kb.google_desc: By adding your portfolio link to your photos, you can trigger the "Licensable" badge in Google Images, making it easier for people to find and credit your original work.
kb.pdf_desc: VeriMedia goes beyond basic cleaning for PDFs. We physically overwrite hidden data streams to ensure that your private info is completely erased and cannot be recovered.
